metadata.title: 【涙腺崩壊】左遷先のボロアパート…隣の「空き部屋」から聞こえる謎のノックと老婆の正体とは？
metadata.description: 左遷されボロアパートで一人暮らしを始めた男の隣室から響く不気味なノック音。そこに誰も住んでいないはずが、苦しそうに咳込む老婆が現れたことで、予想もつかない感動のドラマが動き出す。

packaging_strategy.curiosity_gap: Why is an elderly woman secretly living in a supposedly empty, condemned apartment building, and how is she connected to the company?
packaging_strategy.visual_hook: An eerie yet emotional encounter in a dimly lit apartment hallway with a frail elderly woman holding a glass of water.

composition.camera_angle: Medium shot at eye level, slightly low angle
composition.subject_position: A middle-aged man in a worn business suit stands startled in the center-left, while a frail elderly woman holding a glass of water stands in the center-right.
composition.negative_space: Dark, shadowed wooden walls on the upper-left and side areas, cleanly reserved for text integration.

top.color_description: warm white text with a thin-to-medium dark outline

bottom.color_description: warm white text with a thin-to-medium dark outline

thumbnail.prompt: Create a premium cinematic Japanese YouTube thumbnail as one unified scene in Japanese anime-style semi-realistic illustration, mature adult drama art style with soft gradient shading. The scene depicts a middle-aged Japanese male office worker in a worn suit looking shocked and cautious, standing next to a frail elderly Japanese woman holding a glass of water in a dimly lit, narrow hallway of a dilapidated old wooden apartment building. Cinematic night lighting, moody melancholic atmosphere, highly detailed. Clean negative space is intentionally preserved in the upper-left and lower-right areas against dark shadowed wooden walls. Display the exact Japanese text 「空き部屋のはずが…」 in the top-left area and 「夜な夜な現れる老婆」 in the bottom-right area using clean warm white typography with a thin dark outline. Ensure no text boxes, banners, speech bubbles, split screens, panels, grids, logos, or watermarks are present.
